newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia has small budget surplus so this year.
newsitem.headline: Latvia has small budget surplus so this year.

text.p: Latvia, seeking to have a deficit-free budget this year, has so far in 1997 gained a small budget surplus of 3.658 million lats ($6.5 million), the finance ministry said on Friday.
"The current 1997 budget has exceeded our expectations," a finance ministry spokesman told Reuters.
The deficit-free budget was set after a 1996 deficit of about 35 million lats.
Finance ministry figures, which run to January 22, showed total income of 36.693 million lats and expenditure of 33.035 million lats.
The ministry said it had total internal debt of 194.440 million lats, mostly accounted for by outstanding government Treasury bills of 120.809 million lats.
Other credits were taken from commercial banks to the sum of 23.097 million lats, the state-owned Savings Bank worth 34.747 million lats and semi state-owned Unibanka of 15.788 million lats.
